# bitwarden_item_secure_note (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads an existing Password Manager secure note item without persisting its data in plan or state files. Unlike the `bitwarden_item_secure_note` data source, values are not stored in plan or state. Use the result in an ephemeral context, such as a provider configuration or a write-only resource argument.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "bitwarden_item_secure_note" "example" {
  id = "37a66d6a-96c1-4f04-9a3c-b1fc0135669e"
}

# Alternatively, search for a uniquely named secure note item.
ephemeral "bitwarden_item_secure_note" "by_search" {
  search = "VPN/Pre-sharedSecret"
}

# Pass ephemeral.bitwarden_item_secure_note.example.notes to a provider
# configuration or a write-only resource argument. Ordinary resource
# arguments and root outputs cannot accept ephemeral values. Prefer this
# over data.bitwarden_item_secure_note when the note should not be stored in state.
#
# Write-only arguments require Terraform 1.11+ and explicit
# support in the receiving provider. Use that resource's documented version
# or revision argument to trigger updates when the note changes.
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_collection_id` (String) Filter search results by collection ID.
- `filter_folder_id` (String) Filter search results by folder ID.
- `filter_organization_id` (String) Filter search results by organization ID.
- `id` (String) Identifier.
- `search` (String) Search items matching the search string.

### Read-Only

- `attachments` (Attributes List) List of item attachments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments))
- `collection_ids` (Set of String) Identifier of the collections the item belongs to.
- `creation_date` (String) Date the item was created.
- `deleted_date` (String) Date the item was deleted.
- `favorite` (Boolean) Mark as a Favorite to have item appear at the top of your Vault in the UI.
- `field` (Attributes List, Sensitive) Extra fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field))
- `folder_id` (String) Identifier of the folder.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `notes` (String, Sensitive) Free-form notes.
- `organization_id` (String) Identifier of the organization.
- `reprompt` (Boolean) Require master password 're-prompt' when displaying secret in the UI.
- `revision_date` (String) Last time the item was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachments`

Read-Only:

- `file_name` (String) File name. Required if specifying `content` in a resource.
- `id` (String) Identifier.
- `size` (String) Size in bytes
- `size_name` (String) Size as string
- `url` (String) Download URL of the attachment. May include a short-lived access token.


<a id="nestedatt--field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the field.
- `text` (String) Value of a text field.
